preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The length of the array A must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[i] <= 100000 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: All elements in the array A must be positive integers between 1 and 100,000.
The frequency of each integer in the array A must be at most 2.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the maximum possible Hamming distance and the array B.
The length of the array B must be equal to the length of the array A.

postconditions.expression: all(A[i] != B[i] for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: The Hamming distance between A and B must be maximized, meaning all elements at corresponding indices must be different.
